decanter-2018.name: Decanter, Brunello di Montalcino 2018 full report
decanter-2018.note: Decanter score known only from a search-result summary; page is paywalled and was not read. Rating 3.5/5.

claims.claim: Winter was cold, with snow in late winter and lows near -10C, and brought rain and snow after the 2017 water deficit. Spring was wet and cool.
claims.note: Three sources agree. Fine+Rare says rainfall to end of May beat all of 2017.

claims.claim: Budburst came in mid-April and flowering in late May. Flowering went smoothly. Downy mildew was a problem in the wet spring.
claims.note: No frost reported after the winter cold snap. Isolated hail reported in a search summary only.

claims.claim: Summer was moderate. July had a spike to 35 to 36C, but mid-June to late August mostly stayed near 30C, with no vine shutdown. Many estates green-harvested in August to help ripeness.
claims.note: The Consorzio calls June and July hot, Fine+Rare calls it moderate.

claims.claim: September brought rain. Fine+Rare reports two storms dried by westerly winds, and the Consorzio says late-September rain and cooler weather made wineries start Sangiovese earlier.
claims.quote: Rain and cooler temperatures in late September
claims.note: Estates differed. Some started early (Biondi Santi 16 September) and others waited about five days (Sassetti until 10 October).

claims.claim: Volumes were among the lowest of recent years, roughly 25% below 2016 and 2017, according to Fine+Rare. The Consorzio gives no yield figure and notes medium-high berry weight.
claims.note: One merchant figure. It sits oddly with the very short 2017 crop, so treat the comparison with care.

claims.claim: Sangiovese is classic and elegant, fresh and floral, with high acidity, medium body and soft, balanced tannins. It is compared to 2008 and 2013. Few Riservas were made.
claims.note: Three sources agree on freshness and elegance.

claims.claim: One reference says concentration and ageing potential are weaker than top years. Fine+Rare says high acidity and low pH give long ageing.
claims.quote: Perhaps not one of the best Montalcino vintages

claims.claim: The Consorzio rated 2018 four stars, 'excellent'. Decanter reportedly gives 3.5/5. Quality varies by picking date and producer.
claims.note: Consorzio read directly. Decanter from a search summary.

conflicts: Ageing: Italy's Finest Wines doubts it, Fine+Rare points to high acidity and low pH.
Summer: moderate (Fine+Rare) against hot June and July (Consorzio).
Harvest: some started earlier to protect fruit, others delayed to ripen.
gaps: Hail only in a search summary.

sheet.vintage: 2018 was a cool, wet-spring year with a showery September. The Sangiovese is fresh, elegant and floral with soft tannins. The Consorzio gave it four stars.
